parameters.query:
WITH last_artifact AS (
  SELECT project_id
  FROM architecture.artifacts
  WHERE meta->>'jobId' = $1
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name
FROM architecture.projects p
WHERE p.id = (SELECT project_id FROM last_artifact);

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.type)
  a.type,
  a.content,
  a.meta,
  a.version,
  a.created_at
FROM architecture.artifacts a
WHERE a.meta->>'jobId' = $1
ORDER BY a.type, a.version DESC;

parameters.jsCode:
const { byType } = $json;
const brd = byType.brd;

const md = [
  `# Business Requirements Document: ${$json.projectName}`,
  '',
  '## Problem Statement',
  '',
  `### Current State\n${brd?.problemStatement?.currentState || ''}`,
  '',
  '### Pain Points',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.problemStatement?.painPoints) ? brd.problemStatement.painPoints.map(p => `- ${p}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  `### Impact\n${brd?.problemStatement?.impact || ''}`,
  '',
  '## Business Objectives',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.businessObjectives) ? brd.businessObjectives.map(o => `- ${o}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Success Metrics (KPIs)',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.successCriteria) ? brd.successCriteria.map(s => `- ${s}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Stakeholders',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.stakeholders) ? brd.stakeholders.map(s => `- ${typeof s === 'string' ? s : JSON.stringify(s)}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Constraints & Assumptions',
  '### Constraints',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.constraints) ? brd.constraints.map(c => `- ${c}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '### Assumptions',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.assumptions) ? brd.assumptions.map(a => `- ${a}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Scope',
  '',
  `### In Scope\n${(brd?.scope && brd.scope.inScope) ? brd.scope.inScope : ''}`,
  '',
  '### Features',
  ...(((brd?.scope && Array.isArray(brd.scope.features)) ? brd.scope.features : []).map(f => `- ${f}`) || ['-']),
  '',
  '### Out of Scope',
  ...(((brd?.scope && Array.isArray(brd.scope.outOfScope)) ? brd.scope.outOfScope : []).map(f => `- ${f}`) || ['-']),
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { ...$json, brdMarkdown: md } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, jobId: $json.jobId, projectSlug: $json.projectSlug, repo: 'shlapolosa/software-delivery', branch: $json.projectSlug, paths: { repoHost: '/local-ai-packaged/projects/software-delivery', repoContainer: '/app/projects/software-delivery', projectFolder: $json.projectSlug + '-docs' } } }}
